title: Bound observer-irrelevant evidence materialization before production change

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: reduce canonical relation-compiler bloat and bounded-memory exposure without adding a parallel fact store, compiler, cache or evidence abstraction

finding.observer_irrelevant_materialization: The canonical compiler always computes _forest_edge_atoms(edge) for every selected Forest edge and always builds binding.digest plus binding.evidence_sha256s for every selected verified binding before recording a semantic fact. The later scalar-admission branch uses those evidence bundles only for the evidence-dag observer; Boolean emits True and natural emits unit 1 from semantic coordinate identity alone. Consequently Boolean/natural compilation pays canonical edge hashing, evidence copying/sorting/deduplication and per-coordinate evidence-bundle set retention that cannot affect the emitted scalar block or CompiledRelationBlocks digest beyond identities already bound by source_forest_sha256/snapshot subject and source counts.
finding.boundedness_risk: ForestEdge is a legacy immutable IR record without a relation-compiler-specific evidence-term cap. EvidenceValue enforces MAX_EVIDENCE_TERM_ATOMS only when the evidence-dag scalar is finally constructed, but Boolean/natural currently materialize the same raw witness bundles even though they never consume them. This is avoidable intermediate memory/work, not a benchmark win claim.
finding.semantic_boundary: GPU-49 pins that duplicate evidence witnesses must not increase natural multiplicity. Therefore eliding witness-bundle materialization for Boolean/natural is semantically aligned with the existing contract as long as semantic endpoint/relation deduplication, Forest/snapshot digest binding, source counts, completeness checks, hyperedge refusal and evidence-dag behavior remain unchanged.

decision.summary: Freeze this as the next bounded Gardener implementation target rather than introducing another fact representation. In the existing compile_relation_blocks owner, observer selection should decide whether provenance bundles are materialized: evidence-dag retains current canonical Forest/binding witness bundles; Boolean and natural should record only semantic coordinate presence and must not call _forest_edge_atoms or compute binding evidence solely for discarded provenance. The output block/digest for Boolean/natural must remain byte-for-byte equivalent on the same subject. Evidence-dag must remain behaviorally identical and bounded by the canonical EvidenceValue contract.
decision.gardener_note: No production file is changed in GPU-50. The packet isolates a deletion/avoidance opportunity inside the one existing compiler and explicitly rejects a second fact store, evidence cache, backend, registry or compiler path.

focused_next_contracts: Boolean selected-edge compilation does not call _forest_edge_atoms while preserving the exact TypedRelationBlock and CompiledRelationBlocks digest produced for the same subject
natural selected-edge compilation likewise avoids evidence witness materialization and still emits unit 1 per deduplicated semantic coordinate
Boolean/natural selected verified bindings do not compute/store provenance bundles that cannot affect their scalar output
evidence-dag compilation retains canonical Forest edge digest/evidence and verified-binding evidence alternatives exactly as GPU-49 pins
selected-evidence pruning, endpoint completeness, retained-hyperedge refusal, source counts and discover-all behavior remain unchanged

verification.notes: Closed research packet only. No production behavior changed; exact source/blob evidence scopes the next in-owner implementation and no benchmark claim is made.

claims.correctness: observer-irrelevant provenance materialization is isolated as a bounded Gardener target; production behavior is not yet claimed changed
